implementation_notes: Default arguments and data classes remove most builder and factory boilerplate; coroutines and Flow replace thread and callback plumbing; sealed classes over visitor hierarchies. Use `buildList`/`buildString` over manual mutable accumulators.

pitfalls: Dependency-injection frameworks with kapt/KSP cost for a small graph
